title: mbwf-1992-world
label: Wolverine

won.source: The newsletter of 18 March 1993: "WOLVERINE became World Champion on Friday Ferocity Show #2 (02.26.93), by defeating DEATH CROC" (promotions/mbwf-1992/archive/m-b-w-f-news-1993-03-18.html).

how: Beat Death Croc at Friday Ferocity #2; billed to defend against Scourge at Friday Ferocity #5 on 19 March 1993; lost the title to Death Croc at Grapple Wars.

title: mbwf-1992-world
label: Death Croc
how: Beat Wolverine with the Croc Bite at Grapple Wars; the show script calls it his second reign. A post of 1 October 1993 signed with his name calls him a former two-time champion of the league, so the reign was over by then.

title: mbwf-1992-world
label: Death Croc

won.source: The league's update of 19 October 1992 already names him World Champion; no start date or match survives (promotions/mbwf-1992/archive/mbwf-info-1992-10-19.html).

how: Champion by 19 October 1992, nine days after the league opened; lost the belt to Wolverine at Friday Ferocity #2.

title: mbwf-1992-master-of-the-ring
label: The Gross Gladiator

won.source: The newsletter of 18 March 1993: "THE GROSS GLADIATOR took the Master of the Ring title when he defeated SCOURGE on 11.30.92, on a Monday Madness show" (promotions/mbwf-1992/archive/m-b-w-f-news-1993-03-18.html).

how: Beat Scourge on a Monday Madness show, with a defence due within 14 days; lost the title to the Great Tadaka at Grapple Wars.

title: mbwf-1992-master-of-the-ring
label: The Great Tadaka

won.source: Grapple Wars 1: "*NEW* Master of the Ring" (promotions/mbwf-1992/archive/m-b-w-f-grapple-wars-1-part-1-1993-06-18.html).

how: Pinned the Gross Gladiator in the third match after referee Don Animal counted three over a shoulder the announcers thought was off the mat.

title: mbwf-1992-master-of-the-ring
label: Scourge
how: Holder when the Gross Gladiator beat him on a Monday Madness show on 30 November 1992; no earlier date survives.

title: mbwf-1992-air-wave
label: The Electric Youth

won.source: The newsletter of 18 March 1993: the title "was won by THE ELECTRIC YOUTH at the M.B.W.F.'s WINTER BASH 1992" (promotions/mbwf-1992/archive/m-b-w-f-news-1993-03-18.html).

how: Beat Evil Einstein at Winter Bash 1992; billed to defend against him again at Friday Ferocity #6 on 26 March 1993; still champion when he beat Scourge at Grapple Wars.

title: mbwf-1992-ladies-world
label: Angel Pit Bull
how: Beat the Countess with her Flip Side finisher.

title: mbwf-1992-ladies-world
label: The Countess
how: The first woman to enter the league, and so champion automatically; lost the title to Angel Pit Bull at Grapple Wars.

title: mbwf-1992-tag-team
label: Pain Unbound

won.source: Grapple Wars 1: "*NEW* World Tag Team Champions" (promotions/mbwf-1992/archive/m-b-w-f-grapple-wars-1-part-2-1993-06-18.html).

how: Beat the Slammers when Master 'Bud' Wiser did not kick out of the pin.

title: mbwf-1992-tag-team
label: Tempest

won.source: The newsletter of 18 March 1993: "TEMPEST were the first team entered into this division and automatically became the World Champions" (promotions/mbwf-1992/archive/m-b-w-f-news-1993-03-18.html).

how: The first team entered in the men's tag division. Champions in the first Friday Ferocity re-run (February 1993); the Slammers were billed against them for the belts at Friday Ferocity #6 on 26 March 1993 and were champions by 14 June 1993.

title: mbwf-1992-tag-team
label: The Slammers
how: Champions by 14 June 1993, when the league's status post names them; the date and the match they won them in are not given. Lost the belts to Pain Unbound at Grapple Wars.

title: mbwf-1992-all-comers
label: Colossus
how: Won the final of the All-Comers tournament over Noose Lupack and was the title's first champion.
